facts.text: American Flag was deployed at Sea of Tranquility during Apollo 11 in 1969.

Planted by Armstrong and Aldrin approximately 8 metres from the LM. The nylon flag had a horizontal rod to keep it extended in the vacuum. After decades of unfiltered UV, it is almost certainly bleached white.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Documented materials behavior in the lunar vacuum and showed the difficulty of planting objects in compacted regolith — the pole only penetrated about 15 centimetres.
Status: Preserved at Sea of Tranquility.
Buzz Aldrin reported seeing the flag knocked over by the ascent engine exhaust; LROC images from 2009 show no shadow at this location, confirming it likely fell.
